title: Domain-only routing without speculative principle lenses
task: Review cancellation handling for an in-process worker. The task is limited to its shutdown contract.
context: Single process; one worker; no broker or remote failure boundary.
No structural refactor or alternative representation is requested.
evidence: The worker owns an async task and must await cancellation before shutdown returns.
Existing architecture is adequate; only lifecycle semantics are in question.
tempting_wrong_recommendation: Load all principle lenses or treat the worker as distributed.
expected_decision_properties: Use concurrency guidance and language guidance only if its mechanism matters.
Allow zero principle lenses; do not manufacture a conflict.
unacceptable_reasoning: A queue necessarily implies a distributed system.
Every substantive review requires every lens.
verification_expectations: Test cancellation during active work and assert shutdown joins the worker.
